items.title: Abdul El-Sayed
items.description: Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed is an American epidemiologist, public health administrator, academic, and politician who is the United States senator-elect from the state of Michigan.

items.title: James Talarico
items.description: James Dell Talarico is an American politician and educator who is the United States senator-elect from Texas. A member of the Democratic Party, he has served as a member of the Texas House of Representatives since 2018.

items.title: Gina Hinojosa
items.description: Regina Inez Hinojosa is an American politician and lawyer who is the governor-elect of Texas. A member of the Democratic Party, she has represented the 49th district in the Texas House of Representatives since 2017.

items.title: 2026 United States elections
items.description: Elections in the United States were held on November 3, 2026. items.title: Jon Ossoff
items.description: Thomas Jonathan Ossoff is an American politician who has served as the senior United States senator from Georgia since 2021. He is the youngest incumbent U.S. senator, and a member of the Democratic Party.

items.title: United States midterm election
items.description: Midterm elections in the United States are the general elections that are held near the midpoint of a president's four-year term of office, on Election Day on the Tuesday after the first Monday in November.
